newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&Ps end sharply higher after 17-pt rise.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&Ps end sharply higher after 17-pt rise.

text.p: April 22 - U.S. June S&P 500s closed sharply higher after staging a 17-point intraday advance. June rose to 781.15, above resistance at 780.00. Traders said the rally was sparked by gains in the U.S. T-bond market and talk of an imminent budget deal. June rallied through the 2-1/2-week high and trendline resistance level of 774.60 in active trade.
